scope: Four generated kitchen pan 4x2 full-object interaction sheets.
design_policy: Animation generation preserves the four approved source pan designs; new acting is limited to material response, depth articulation, and visible existing joints/handles.
delivery_policy: No effect lines, sparkles, bubbles, water, background, frame duplication, interpolation, or static whole-object-rotation substitute.

generation.mode: reference-guided generation via one surfaced conversation image
generation.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: production 4x2 game animation sprite sheet for Mermaid Roshan castle kitchen
Input image: the single supplied approved pan_1 cutout is the sole identity, topology, material, color, outline, and style reference. It depicts ONE hanging pan only.
Primary request: Create exactly eight unique chronological full-object animation states of this exact small shallow copper hanging pan, arranged as a strict 4 columns by 2 rows sheet, read left-to-right across the top row and then left-to-right across the bottom row.
Silhouette lock: Every frame contains exactly one circular copper bowl, exactly one narrow vertical suspension neck, and exactly one small circular hook eye at the top. There is nothing behind, beside, nested with, or attached to the bowl. Do not interpret neighboring crop remnants as part of the pan.
Motion acting: The top hook-eye center stays at the exact same normalized coordinate in all eight cells. Animate a believable struck-copper ringing response within the one pan itself, not a flat whole-pan rotation: the narrow neck bends and rebounds minutely below the fixed hook; the shallow circular rim alternately compresses into subtle perpendicular ovals; the hammered center dimples inward then springs forward; visible concavity and copper highlight change with the material flex.
Eight beats: (1) neutral front rest, (2) neck bows subtly left and rim begins to flex, (3) rim compresses horizontally and center moves inward, (4) vertical-oval rebound and center forward, (5) strongest gong-like dish flex, (6) smaller opposite recoil and neck rattle, (7) damped shallow dish flex, (8) almost settled with a tiny residual neck bend and a distinct rim shape.
Style/medium: preserve the approved polished pastel storybook cutout, warm copper/gold paint, navy-purple contour, soft painted highlights, child-readable silhouette.
Composition/framing: each equal cell contains the entire one-pan silhouette at identical scale with generous padding; no parts cross cell boundaries; hook-eye center aligns perfectly across all cells.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat uniform solid #FF00FF chroma-key background only.
Constraints: Preserve exact identity and single-piece topology; all 8 states visibly distinct; subtle plausible thin hammered-copper flex. No secondary bowl, no rear crescent, no side flap, no lid, no food, no utensils, no water, no fire, no wall rail, no room background, no text, labels, numbers, panel borders, grid lines, cast shadows, reflections, or floor.
Avoid: simple whole-object rotation or bounce; extra or detached pieces; duplicated action frames; motion/effect lines; sparkles; bubbles; glow bursts; magenta anywhere in the pan; watermark.

rejected_attempts.reason: Rejected: invented a second half-bowl/rear crescent, violating the approved single-pan topology.

normalization.operation: Split generated 4x2 canvas into eight cells, uniformly resize each complete cell to 256x256, then integer-translate the whole cell so the enclosed top hook-eye center is (128,36).

audit.novel_item_specific_mechanics: Hammered shallow bowl rings through alternating rim compression and center dimple/pop while its neck bends below the fixed hook.
